rule_dispositions.HLT-001-DEAD-MARKER: The one legacy fallback marker in the pinned training builder remains enumerated; this disposition does not claim the fallback was repaired.
rule_dispositions.HLT-023-INPUT-BOUNDARY-GAP: Static marker findings adjacent to the audited pinned calls remain enumerated; this disposition does not claim a general boundary repair.
rule_dispositions.HLT-033-PYTHON-BAD-BEHAVIOR: P37 packet sites are documented in jankurai-pyexec-p37-exceptions-20261102.md; adjudication is per exact source identity and finding fingerprint. This entry does not claim these findings were removed.
rule_dispositions.HLT-033-PYTHON-BAD-BEHAVIOR:duplication: The exact copy-unit finding is in an immutable historical experiment runtime; it remains enumerated, not claimed fixed.
rule_dispositions.HLT-033-PYTHON-BAD-BEHAVIOR:sql: The table identifier is a fixed internal constant and value data remains parameter-bound; the finding remains enumerated pending detector-specific adjudication.

scope_reason: These exact test, generated-admission, training-tool, and historical research files contain the 42 registered HLT-033 sites and file-level findings recorded below. The H155 executor loads only H153 Git blobs at a fixed commit after SHA-256 checks; H154/H158/H159/H161/H164/H168/H173 runners load the manifest-pinned H50 fused input and SHA-verified fixed-commit guard only after input and executor verification. The exact executor hashes for these files remain in their manifests. The file-scoped auditor skip is coarse, so CI re-audits every whole file and requires exact source SHA-256 plus exact rule/fingerprint inventory; a changed-scope repository audit verifies all raw findings and copy-code classes touching registered paths. Any byte drift, missing finding, or new finding fails closed.
